app.name: Sololearn: Learn to Code
app.description: Learn to code with bite-sized lessons in Python, JavaScript, C++, and more. Includes an AI chatbot (Kodie) and interactive coding playground.

verdict.one_liner: A solid coding app, but it shares data with advertisers and tracks your activity across websites.
verdict.summary: Sololearn collects your name, email, age, device info, and online activity to run its coding courses. It shares anonymized demographic data with advertisers, uses analytics services that track you across sites, and sends anything you type in its AI chatbot to OpenAI. While it offers GDPR/CCPA rights and says it does not sell personal information, some data remains on its servers even after you delete your account.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app shares data with advertisers and analytics networks, tracks your activity across other websites, and sends AI chat inputs to OpenAI. Consider this if you are privacy-conscious, especially when using the AI features.

red.title: AI chatbot sends your messages to OpenAI
red.plain_english: Anything you type in the AI chatbot Kodie or the AI playground is sent to OpenAI to generate responses. If you include personal info in those messages, OpenAI receives it too.

red.title: Targeted ads and cross-site tracking
red.plain_english: The app uses cookies and web beacons to show you targeted ads and can track your online activity even after you leave the app or website.

red.title: Demographic data shared with advertisers
red.plain_english: Your general location and usage patterns are shared with advertisers in a non-personally identifiable form so they can pick who sees their ads.

red.title: Some data kept after you delete your account
red.plain_english: Even if you ask Sololearn to delete your information or deactivate your account, some data may stay on their servers for legal, research, or business reasons.

red.title: Analytics providers track you across websites
red.plain_english: Google Analytics, Facebook, and other analytics services monitor how you use the app and other websites over time to build a profile of your interests.

green.title: Explicitly says it does not sell personal data
green.plain_english: The company clearly states it does not sell your personal information to third parties, which is better than many free apps.

green.title: Offers GDPR and CCPA privacy rights
green.plain_english: If you live in the EU, Brazil, or certain US states, you can request access, deletion, or export of your data, and the company provides a contact email and form to do so.

green.title: Accounts are password protected
green.plain_english: Your account is secured with a password, and the company says it uses encryption and anonymization to help protect your information.

green.title: You can control what others see on your profile
green.plain_english: Privacy settings let you limit which other users can see your profile details, giving you some control over your public information.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention any access to your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: No references to camera or microphone permissions, recordings, or uploads that would require these sensors.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app collects your general location automatically (likely from your IP address) and uses it to show you locally relevant ads.
categories.detail: IP address and general location are collected automatically. This information is shared with advertisers in non-personally identifiable form for location-based ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: we automatically receive and record information on our server logs from your browser or device, which may include your IP address, general location
concerns: Location inferred from IP address without explicit opt-in
Used for ad targeting even though it is not needed to learn to code

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention accessing your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: There is no reference to contact list access, phonebook uploads, or social graph syncing.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload images and videos to your user profile, but this is optional and controlled by your privacy settings.
categories.detail: User-generated uploads (images, videos) are stored and may be displayed to other users depending on profile privacy settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Certain user profile information, including your name, location, and any video or image content that such user has uploaded to the Services, may be displayed to other users
concerns: Uploaded content may be publicly visible depending on settings

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with advertisers, analytics companies (Google, Facebook), and other service providers to run the app and show you ads.
categories.detail: The policy describes sharing with advertisers (demographic info), analytics providers (Google, Facebook, Fabric), third-party businesses for transactions, and service providers for hosting and payments. While the company says it does not sell personal information, it discloses identifiers and internet activity for business purposes and uses web beacons for ad networks.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may provide any of the information we have collected from you in non-personally identifiable form to an Advertiser
concerns: Demographic and usage data shared with advertisers
Analytics providers track activity across sites
Web beacons allow ad networks to track you elsewhere

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You must provide your name, email, and age to sign up, and the app can link this to third-party accounts like Facebook or Google.
categories.detail: Account creation requires name, age, and email. Third-party login credentials (Facebook, Google) are collected. This data is used for account management, personalization, and is linked to advertising profiles indirectly through demographic sharing.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may collect information such as your name, age, email address, and third-party account credentials (for example, your log-in credentials for Facebook or Google)
concerns: Identity data linked to advertising demographics
Third-party login data transmitted to Sololearn

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app tracks how you use it and other websites to show you targeted ads and personalize content.
categories.detail: Cookies, web beacons, and analytics services are used to track activity on the Services and other websites. This data is used to deliver targeted advertisements and content based on interests. Users can manage some tracking via cookie banners and device settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our advertising partners may also transmit cookies to your browser or device... web beacons also enable ad networks to serve targeted advertisements to you when you visit other websites
concerns: Cross-site tracking via cookies and web beacons
Targeted ads based on usage patterns
Activity tracked even after leaving the service

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app says it is not for kids under 13, but there is no mention of how it actually verifies age.
categories.detail: The policy states the services are not intended for anyone under 13 and that they do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. No age verification mechanism is described.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Services are not intended for use by anyone under the age of 13. As noted in the Terms of Use, we do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from anyone under the age of 13.
concerns: No age verification mechanism described
Coding education app may appeal to children under 13

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your IP address, browser type, and pages you visit, and tracks your online activity even after you leave the app to personalize content.
categories.detail: Server logs collect IP address, browser type, device info, and requested pages. Cookies placed by Sololearn collect information about online activity after users leave the Services. This is used for content customization and service improvement.
categories.policy_excerpt: we automatically receive and record information on our server logs from your browser or device, which may include your IP address, general location, device identification, cookie information
concerns: IP address and browsing activity logged continuously
Cookies track activity on other websites after leaving

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects your device ID, browser type, and other device details automatically, and advertisers can use this to track you across different websites.
categories.detail: Device identification, browser type, and cookie data are collected automatically. Third-party advertisers and analytics services can view, edit, or set their own cookies, effectively building a device fingerprint for cross-site tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: device identification, cookie information, the type of browser and/or device you're using
concerns: Device ID collected automatically
Third-party advertisers can set their own cookies
Used for ad targeting and analytics profiling

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention collecting any health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No references to health metrics, biometric authentication, or physiological data collection.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: If you make a payment, a third-party processor handles it. The app says it does not store your raw card details.
categories.detail: Payment processing is handled by third-party service providers. The policy does not state that Sololearn stores raw payment card data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We employ hosting providers, payment processors, and other service provider companies
concerns: Payment data shared with third-party processors

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request deletion or export of your data, but some information may be kept even after you delete your account.
categories.detail: Users can request update, deletion, stop processing, and data portability via email. However, the policy states that some information may remain after deletion for legal compliance, research, business records, and operations. Information shared with friends remains visible to them.
categories.policy_excerpt: some information may remain in our records after your deletion of such information from your account
concerns: Data retained after deletion for multiple business purposes
Shared content remains visible to others after account deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: If the privacy policy changes, they will post a notice, but simply continuing to use the app counts as agreeing to the new terms.
categories.detail: Material changes are notified by posting a notice on the website and app. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement. No requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will notify you if we make any material changes to this Privacy Policy by posting a notice on our website and the Sololearn application... If you use the Services after any changes to the Privacy Policy have been posted, that means you agree to all of the changes.
concerns: Continued use = automatic acceptance of changes
No active re-consent required
